verdict.rationale: Oyster is an employment and payroll platform, so year-end tax form generation is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence mentions W-2s, 1099s or year-end tax document distribution. Generic claims of multi-country payroll and automated reports are adjacent features and do not show this capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have W-2s and 1099s generated and distributed to workers automatically at year-end
